description: Prepare partial or full withdrawals from one or more owned positions in one plan, collecting fees or Ve33 rewards and keeping the NFTs. Read each position's current_state_query first and request no more liquidity than it decodes; require every inner call to succeed and owner to equal expected_owner. Hand the wallet every principal and earnings estimate and recipient.

liquidity.description: uint128 liquidity, at most the decoded current-state value (positive decimal integer)
